grid_hole_points — DRIVE braidpath op

• Data kinds: image2d → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.grid_hole_points(grid) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import braidpath; braidpath.grid_hole_points(grid) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("grid_hole_points"))

Usage

One representative point per grid hole (connected component of blocked cells not touching the border): the centre [x, y] of the blocked cell nearest the centroid.

Blocked regions touching the border are connected to the outside world and are not holes (they add no path classes). 4-connectivity (same as movement).

Raises: ValueError (the grid is empty, not 2-D, or contains non-finite values —— NaN is not read as “traversable”).
